rationale: Master CBCG statistics hub; anchor node from which all ME banking series are reachable.
English mirror of the same tree; useful for label mapping but not a separate signal producer.
Monetary and financial statistics section with recurring ECB/IMF-methodology releases.
Monthly MFI ZIP dataset — highest-resolution machine-readable banking data for ME.
Quarterly FSI dataset built from supervisory returns; unavailable elsewhere.
Monthly bank/MFI interest-rate statistics; core pricing dimension of the market.
Monthly RTGS/DNS payment traffic datasets plus historical archive.
Quarterly card/ATM/POS/e-money returns — the payments backbone of this cell.
Monthly payment-system operator reports with volumes, values and availability.
Monthly bilingual bulletin with banking and payments statistical annex.
Recurring macro report with derived banking-sector tables and context.
Periodic financial stability report on bank structure, concentration and stress tests.
Recurring macroprudential series adding credit-cycle and vulnerability indicators.
Quarterly bank lending survey; forward-looking soft data no aggregator republishes.
Advance release calendar enabling scheduled fetches and missed-release detection.
Static mandate/methodology page under the statistics portal; reference not a feed.
Reporting decisions and templates reveal held fields and warn of schema changes.
Per-bank quarterly/annual statements enabling market-share and concentration analysis.
Regulator tariff comparison is valuable pricing intel but URL check failed; re-verify liveness.
Registers of payment institutions/agents/EMIs — mine once for the actor universe, refresh occasionally.
Single-year CBCG audited accounts PDF; evidence artifact, parent publications page is the source.
Sitemap used to enumerate canonical statistics URLs and detect page moves.
